edges.description: Crystal is one of the owning project domains in the Velantrim ecosystem.
The Crystal Notion hub provides the current human-readable project route and links to owning subpages.
The Crystal GitHub repository is the executable implementation surface for exact code, tests, PRs, and commits.
Titan is one of the owning project domains in the Velantrim ecosystem.
The Titan Notion page is the current human-readable navigation and project-status surface.
The Titan GitHub repository is the executable source for current code, tests, PRs, and integration implementation.
Titan may orchestrate models, providers, tools, or retrieval components around Crystal workflows, but orchestration does not inherit Crystal evidence or Canon authority.
Native Kernel is one of the owning semantic-constitution project domains in the Velantrim ecosystem.
The Native Kernel Notion route provides current human-readable status, architecture, invariants, and internal navigation.
The Native Kernel GitHub repository holds exact substrate-neutral specifications, tests, and conformance implementation.
Mentaury Soul is the owning cognition, belief, self, identity, and relationship domain in Velantrim.
The Mentaury Soul Notion hub routes to current cognition, identity, research, and quick-reference surfaces.
The Mentaury Soul GitHub repository is the executable/source-controlled surface for exact code, tests, and research documents.
Mentaury Kernel is the cross-domain composition and compatibility specification domain.
The Mentaury Kernel Notion page is the current human-readable route for composition and compatibility work.
The Mentaury Kernel GitHub repository holds exact source-controlled composition specifications and tests.
Native Kernel defines substrate-neutral semantic obligations while Mentaury Kernel handles bounded cross-domain composition; specification transfer does not imply authority transfer.
Mentaury Kernel can describe how information composes across domains, while Mentaury Soul owns cognition/identity semantics; composition is not cognition.
Continuum is the durable process-continuity and rehydration research domain in Velantrim.
The Continuum Notion page preserves the current human-readable research framing, status, and navigation.
The Continuum GitHub repository contains the exact source-controlled implementation and research evidence for Continuum work.
State Validation Lab provides bounded executable experiments relevant to continuity/restoration claims without automatically authorizing Continuum production behavior.
Cognitive OS is the current LLM-era model/tool/routing/evaluation profile within the Velantrim ecosystem, without replacing substrate-neutral cognitive laws.
The Cognitive OS Notion page provides the human-readable research and architecture route for this LLM-era profile.
The Cognitive OS GitHub repository holds exact source-controlled implementation and research material for the LLM-era profile.
CLOS is a research-first cognitive blueprint surface in Velantrim and does not automatically authorize owner adoption or runtime enablement.
The CLOS Notion page provides a current human-readable research route and navigation to related source material.
The CLOS GitHub repository provides source-controlled research material and exact repository state without implying runtime adoption.
The CLOS Drive document preserves long-form cognitive blueprint rationale and research narrative complementary to source-controlled evidence.
Living Culture is the human-facing cultural branch for manifests, songs, poetry, archetypes, and symbolic meaning around Velantrim.
The Living Culture Notion page is the current human-readable navigation surface for cultural materials and child pages.
The culture repository stores source-controlled cultural material and history, but cultural content does not gain technical authority from being versioned.
The Drive cultural index preserves long-form human-readable narrative and routes into manifests, songs, and symbolic material.
Plan & Proposal is the intake surface for external ideas and donor mechanisms before any bounded owner review, implementation, or architecture adoption.
Drive and Notion provide companion views of proposal intake; neither turns a candidate idea into adopted architecture or runtime behavior.
